name: punchwall-radius-damage-shake
description: Validate body-direction radial punch damage falloff, no target lock when facing away, and replicated block vibration before destruction.

args.code:
do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end
local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=15,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,FistMastery=1,Rebirths=0,HonorPowerBonus=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local root=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-40)) p:SetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt',0) local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expectedDamage=G.EffectivePower(15,1,0,0,1,0) local beforeHP={} for _,b in ipairs(workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:GetChildren()) do beforeHP[b.Name]=b:GetAttribute('HP') end local r=c:Invoke("PunchRadius") local folder=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Blocks"] local affected,broken,surviving=0,0,0 local minScale,maxScale=1,0 local exactDamage=true local unchanged=true for _,b in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do local scale=b:GetAttribute("LastRadiusDamageScale") or 0 if scale>0 then local expectedHP=math.max(0,beforeHP[b.Name]-expectedDamage*scale) exactDamage=exactDamage and math.abs(b:GetAttribute('HP')-expectedHP)<1e-6 and scale<=1 and scale>=.08 affected+=1 minScale=math.min(minScale,scale) maxScale=math.max(maxScale,scale) if b:GetAttribute("Broken") then broken+=1 elseif (b:GetAttribute("HP") or 0)<(b:GetAttribute("MaxHP") or 0) then surviving+=1 end elseif b:GetAttribute("HP")~=beforeHP[b.Name] then unchanged=false end end local primary=folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(r.primary)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,outcome=r.outcome,hitCount=r.hitCount,affected=affected,broken=broken,surviving=surviving,minScale=minScale,maxScale=maxScale,primaryBroken=primary and primary:GetAttribute("Broken"),score=r.Score,exactDamage=exactDamage,untouchedOutsideRadius=unchanged})

steps.label: one body-directed punch damages a radius with falloff

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local root=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,0)) local r=c:Invoke("PunchRadius") return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,outcome=r.outcome,broken=r.BrokenDepthBlocks,score=r.Score})

steps.label: facing away causes no damage and proves no target lock

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=100,WallLevel=3,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,FistMastery=1,Rebirths=0,HonorPowerBonus=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local root=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-68),Vector3.new(-2,3,-90)) p:SetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt',0) local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expectedHP=G.Walls[2].hp-G.EffectivePower(100,1,0,0,1,0) local poseBefore=root.Position local function xyz(v) return {x=v.X,y=v.Y,z=v.Z} end local targetBefore=workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild('DepthBlock_L009_C06_R01') local insideTarget=targetBefore and math.abs(poseBefore.X-targetBefore.Position.X)<=targetBefore.Size.X/2 and math.abs(poseBefore.Y-targetBefore.Position.Y)<=targetBefore.Size.Y/2 and math.abs(poseBefore.Z-targetBefore.Position.Z)<=targetBefore.Size.Z/2 local r=c:Invoke("PunchRadius") local poseAfter=root.Position local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Blocks"]:FindFirstChild(tostring(r.primary)) return H:JSONEncode({poseBefore=xyz(poseBefore),poseAfter=xyz(poseAfter),rootTravel=(poseAfter-poseBefore).Magnitude,insideTargetBefore=insideTarget,targetPosition=targetBefore and xyz(targetBefore.Position),targetSize=targetBefore and xyz(targetBefore.Size),ok=r.ok,primary=r.primary,shakeToken=b and b:GetAttribute("ShakeToken"),lastShakeAt=b and b:GetAttribute("LastShakeAt"),survived=b and not b:GetAttribute("Broken"),hp=b and b:GetAttribute("HP"),maxHP=b and b:GetAttribute("MaxHP"),exactDamage=b and math.abs(b:GetAttribute("HP")-expectedHP)<1e-6})

steps.label: tough block starts vibration when damaged but not broken

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local name=p:GetAttribute("LastRadiusPrimary") local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Blocks"]:FindFirstChild(tostring(name)) local base=b and b:GetAttribute("BaseCFrame") return H:JSONEncode({exists=b~=nil,shaking=b and b:GetAttribute("Shaking"),restored=b and base and (b.CFrame.Position-base.Position).Magnitude<0.01})
